components.text:
Circle: medium circle, ritual chalk.

Frees one player from the line of their Original. They become the head of a line of their own, not an Original: their sire bond stays and the ones they sired stay in the Original's line.
Only a witch type can work it, under a lunar eclipse. It needs two bloods that pair: the Original's and the target's, who must be online here and not an Original.
A server can switch line rites off. A refusal gives the ingredients back.
An eclipse happens on some full-moon nights (the server's chance). It lasts until dawn, and an eclipse also counts as a full moon for every rite that needs one.
